PERSIST-ZWP.interpretation: MUST-36/37: probe a zero window using at least one available new or retransmitted octet and allow continued zero-window acknowledgments without a probe retry limit. SHLD-29/30: start after a current-RTO interval of queued zero-window demand; exponentially increase later probe intervals.

PERSIST-OWNERSHIP.interpretation: Enter from no flight and queued data. Use shared UNA/NXT/rtx_buf and per-byte history, never a separate sequence space. Persist owns at most one probe octet with RTO disabled; valid positive-window updates transfer remaining flight to RTO. Replace the parent all-flight-is-RTO invariant with explicit mutually exclusive ownership, retaining the ordinary case.

PERSIST-SCOPE.interpretation: One connection, 16-byte capacity, RMSS/MSS=4 parent model. Independent 1..60 second exponential persist interval; no probe RTT sample, no RTO backoff/retry increment. In-flight shrink-to-zero remains the parent RTO subset; FIN-only zero-window probing, resource/user timeout and congestion recovery remain outside this new slice.
